critical_findings: NEW LEAK: in observation_only the Tier 1 multi-seat adapter (MechExperienceEnv) and the kernel rig.read expose per-seat `score`; in tech_handoff (team_net) it reveals the partner's private net to 1.6 c on every tick, through observations, tool responses and events. Class-3 learning rule re-creates its optimizer every update (strategic.py:121): step size independent of evidence (8*lr for A; ~20% of |w| per update for B) and unstable on a clean synthetic bandit (lock-in on a worse arm, collapse, sharpening without signal). pop_strategic -> REDESIGN; its hash changes are not learning evidence.

Two neural learners in one kernel world share nothing but also do nothing together: no multi-agent driver, 0 cross-learner events, 0 observed signal, yet hashes change every update. Q.7's counters are met with no learning by every existing learner.

Auditor's Leak 1 recharacterised: for abm families `score` is the seat's own net and the legacy reward equals observable revenue minus cost, so the PG result shows a harness reward bypass, not privileged information; learners' REPAIR (S) confirmed.
